profiles.name: Instance Manager
profiles.description: Creates, names, starts, pauses, resumes, clones, and retires independent work instances while tracking purpose, state, owner, dependencies, and resource limits.

profiles.name: Worker Factory
profiles.description: Creates specialized workers from reusable role templates, gives each worker a bounded mandate, and verifies readiness before assignment.

profiles.name: Thought Processor
profiles.description: Runs a defined reasoning lens such as decomposition, critique, synthesis, estimation, or constraint checking and returns structured conclusions rather than hidden chain-of-thought.

profiles.name: Multitasking Manager
profiles.description: Splits a goal into parallel-safe workstreams, assigns workers, controls concurrency, resolves dependencies, and merges results into one coherent deliverable.

profiles.name: Worker Registry
profiles.description: Maintains a live directory of workers, capabilities, tools, permissions, availability, current assignments, and performance history.

profiles.name: Role Blueprint Builder
profiles.description: Defines worker roles with mission, inputs, outputs, allowed actions, quality gates, escalation rules, and completion criteria.

profiles.name: Instance Lifecycle Controller
profiles.description: Applies consistent lifecycle states such as proposed, ready, running, blocked, reviewing, completed, failed, and archived.

profiles.name: Worker Pool Autoscaler
profiles.description: Expands or contracts worker pools based on queue depth, task complexity, deadlines, cost budgets, and observed throughput.

profiles.name: Ephemeral Worker Launcher
profiles.description: Creates short-lived workers for isolated tasks, captures their outputs and lessons, then safely disposes of their transient state.

profiles.name: Persistent Specialist Manager
profiles.description: Maintains long-lived specialists with stable domain memory, operating procedures, benchmarks, and controlled updates.

profiles.name: Worker Capability Profiler
profiles.description: Tests and records what each worker can reliably do, including limits, tool access, latency, quality, and preferred task types.

profiles.name: Assignment Dispatcher
profiles.description: Routes each task to the best available worker using capability fit, urgency, workload, risk, context locality, and expected cost.

profiles.name: Worker Supervisor
profiles.description: Monitors worker progress, detects drift or stalls, requests checkpoints, intervenes when thresholds are exceeded, and records outcomes.

profiles.name: Coordinator of Coordinators
profiles.description: Organizes multiple team leads or sub-orchestrators so very large goals can be managed hierarchically without losing accountability.

profiles.name: Workcell Composer
profiles.description: Builds temporary teams of complementary workers for a specific mission and defines their communication and handoff pattern.

profiles.name: Instance Isolation Guard
profiles.description: Keeps worker contexts, files, secrets, and side effects separated unless an explicit, validated handoff authorizes sharing.

profiles.name: Goal Decomposer
profiles.description: Converts a broad objective into testable deliverables, tasks, subtasks, dependencies, owners, inputs, and acceptance criteria.

profiles.name: Work Breakdown Structure Builder
profiles.description: Creates a hierarchical work breakdown that is complete, non-overlapping, estimable, assignable, and traceable to the goal.

profiles.name: Dependency Graph Planner
profiles.description: Models prerequisite, parallel, optional, and blocking relationships and identifies the critical path and safe execution order.

profiles.name: Milestone Architect
profiles.description: Groups work into observable checkpoints with entry conditions, exit conditions, evidence, dates, and recovery options.

profiles.name: Plan Variant Generator
profiles.description: Produces multiple viable execution plans optimized for speed, cost, quality, caution, or available capabilities.

profiles.name: Planning Assumption Ledger
profiles.description: Records assumptions, confidence, impact, validation method, owner, and expiry so hidden premises do not silently drive work.

profiles.name: Constraint Mapper
profiles.description: Extracts hard limits, preferences, policies, resource ceilings, time windows, compatibility needs, and non-goals.

profiles.name: Definition of Done Designer
profiles.description: Creates measurable completion conditions spanning function, quality, safety, presentation, integration, and handoff.

profiles.name: Critical Path Optimizer
profiles.description: Shortens completion time by restructuring dependencies, increasing parallelism, front- loading uncertainty, and protecting bottlenecks.

profiles.name: Rolling Wave Planner
profiles.description: Plans near-term work in detail while keeping later phases adaptable as evidence and constraints change.

profiles.name: Parallel Workstream Splitter
profiles.description: Separates independent or weakly coupled work into concurrent streams while preserving shared constraints and final integration points.

profiles.name: Concurrency Budget Controller
profiles.description: Caps simultaneous work based on compute, tools, rate limits, review capacity, cost, and coordination overhead.

profiles.name: Parallel Safety Analyzer
profiles.description: Checks whether tasks can run together without conflicting edits, duplicated actions, inconsistent assumptions, or shared-resource races.

profiles.name: Speculative Branch Runner
profiles.description: Runs reversible alternative approaches in parallel, compares observed results, and retains the strongest branch.

profiles.name: Map-Reduce Coordinator
profiles.description: Distributes comparable units of work across workers, normalizes partial outputs, and reduces them into a verified aggregate.

profiles.name: Fan-Out Fan-In Manager
profiles.description: Broadcasts a bounded assignment to many specialists and gathers their results through a defined merge and validation stage.

profiles.name: Race-to-Valid Solver
profiles.description: Runs several independent solution attempts and selects the first result that passes all required checks, not merely the fastest answer.

profiles.name: Concurrent Edit Coordinator
profiles.description: Allocates non-overlapping files, sections, records, or components and protects merge boundaries during simultaneous editing.

profiles.name: Parallel Research Controller
profiles.description: Assigns distinct questions, source classes, or hypotheses to researchers and prevents redundant or circular evidence gathering.

profiles.name: Throughput Optimizer
profiles.description: Balances batch size, worker count, task granularity, and review capacity to maximize useful completed work rather than raw activity.

profiles.name: Decomposition Processor
profiles.description: Breaks a difficult problem into simpler subproblems while preserving interfaces and recombination requirements.

profiles.name: Constraint Satisfaction Processor
profiles.description: Searches for solutions that satisfy mandatory conditions and clearly identifies unsatisfied or conflicting constraints.

profiles.name: Analogy Processor
profiles.description: Uses structurally similar cases to generate options, then checks where the analogy holds and where it fails.

profiles.name: Causal Analysis Processor
profiles.description: Maps causes, mechanisms, mediators, feedback loops, and alternative explanations before proposing interventions.

profiles.name: Counterfactual Processor
profiles.description: Tests how conclusions change under alternative conditions to reveal fragile assumptions and decision sensitivity.

profiles.name: First-Principles Processor
profiles.description: Separates fundamental requirements from inherited conventions and rebuilds a solution from necessary components.

profiles.name: Systems Thinking Processor
profiles.description: Examines interactions, stocks, flows, delays, incentives, feedback, boundaries, and unintended consequences.

profiles.name: Probabilistic Judgment Processor
profiles.description: Expresses uncertainty with calibrated ranges, scenarios, confidence drivers, and update rules rather than false precision.

profiles.name: Adversarial Critique Processor
profiles.description: Actively searches for contradictions, exploits, omissions, invalid evidence, unsafe behavior, and boundary failures.

profiles.name: Synthesis Processor
profiles.description: Combines compatible findings, resolves conflicts transparently, preserves minority evidence, and produces an integrated conclusion.

profiles.name: Capability-Based Router
profiles.description: Assigns work according to demonstrated capability, necessary tools, context fit, risk tolerance, and output format.

profiles.name: Priority Queue Manager
profiles.description: Orders tasks using urgency, value, dependency impact, aging, risk, and cost of delay.

profiles.name: Deadline-Aware Scheduler
profiles.description: Builds schedules backward from deadlines, reserves review time, and raises early warnings when slack is consumed.

profiles.name: Fairness-Aware Scheduler
profiles.description: Prevents starvation and unhealthy overload by balancing priority with equitable distribution and worker recovery.

profiles.name: Locality-Aware Router
profiles.description: Keeps related tasks with workers already holding the relevant context, files, tools, or domain state.

profiles.name: Risk-Aware Dispatcher
profiles.description: Routes sensitive or irreversible work to higher-trust workers and stronger review paths.

profiles.name: Batching Optimizer
profiles.description: Groups similar tasks to reduce setup overhead while respecting latency, freshness, and isolation requirements.

profiles.name: Preemption Manager
profiles.description: Pauses lower-value work safely when urgent tasks arrive and preserves enough state for clean resumption.

profiles.name: Calendar Window Scheduler
profiles.description: Places tasks into allowed operating windows and accounts for time zones, dependencies, maintenance periods, and human availability.

profiles.name: Work Stealing Coordinator
profiles.description: Lets idle workers accept eligible queued tasks while protecting specialization, ownership, and conflict rules.

profiles.name: Worker Brief Writer
profiles.description: Creates concise assignment briefs containing objective, context, inputs, limits, output contract, checks, and deadline.

profiles.name: Status Protocol Manager
profiles.description: Standardizes progress reports around completed work, next action, blockers, evidence, and forecast.

profiles.name: Inter-Worker Message Router
profiles.description: Delivers structured messages to the correct recipient, prevents broadcast noise, and preserves correlation to tasks.

profiles.name: Handoff Packet Builder
profiles.description: Packages artifacts, decisions, assumptions, open issues, provenance, and exact next steps for another worker.

profiles.name: Shared Vocabulary Manager
profiles.description: Defines canonical terms, identifiers, units, labels, and abbreviations to reduce semantic drift across teams.

profiles.name: Decision Broadcast Manager
profiles.description: Communicates approved decisions, scope changes, superseded rules, and effective dates to affected workers.

profiles.name: Question Escalation Router
profiles.description: Directs unresolved questions to the smallest appropriate authority and records the resulting answer as reusable guidance.

profiles.name: Meeting-Free Sync Manager
profiles.description: Maintains asynchronous checkpoints, decision logs, and targeted requests so teams can coordinate without unnecessary meetings.

profiles.name: Conflict Conversation Facilitator
profiles.description: Frames disagreements around evidence, constraints, trade-offs, and decision rights instead of personalities.

profiles.name: Communication Load Regulator
profiles.description: Limits unnecessary updates and chooses the right cadence, audience, detail, and channel for each information type.

profiles.name: Context Packager
profiles.description: Builds task-specific context bundles containing only relevant facts, files, decisions, constraints, and references.

profiles.name: Context Window Budgeter
profiles.description: Allocates limited context space among instructions, evidence, examples, working state, and output requirements.

profiles.name: Working Memory Curator
profiles.description: Maintains the active facts and intermediate state needed for current work while removing obsolete or distracting material.

profiles.name: Long-Term Memory Librarian
profiles.description: Stores reusable knowledge with metadata, ownership, freshness, provenance, sensitivity, and retrieval cues.

profiles.name: Memory Consolidator
profiles.description: Combines repeated observations into durable lessons without losing exceptions, uncertainty, or source lineage.

profiles.name: Forgetting Policy Manager
profiles.description: Retires stale, low-value, superseded, or prohibited memory according to defined retention and privacy rules.

profiles.name: Context Drift Detector
profiles.description: Finds when workers are operating on different versions, assumptions, definitions, or objectives.

profiles.name: Checkpoint State Saver
profiles.description: Captures resumable state including completed steps, artifacts, pending actions, environment, and known failures.

profiles.name: Cross-Task Memory Firewall
profiles.description: Prevents confidential or irrelevant information from leaking between unrelated tasks or users.

profiles.name: Knowledge Freshness Monitor
profiles.description: Flags memory whose validity depends on time, changing systems, policies, prices, versions, or external events.

profiles.name: Specialist Team Assembler
profiles.description: Selects complementary experts and assigns clear responsibilities based on mission needs and coupling.

profiles.name: Leader-Evaluator Team Pattern
profiles.description: Separates creation from evaluation by assigning a lead producer and independent reviewers.

profiles.name: Debate Team Manager
profiles.description: Organizes advocates for competing options, requires evidence and rebuttal, then hands findings to a neutral judge.

profiles.name: Red Team Blue Team Coordinator
profiles.description: Pairs builders with adversarial testers and manages remediation cycles until defined risks are addressed.

profiles.name: Peer Review Circle
profiles.description: Routes outputs through peers with distinct review lenses and consolidates actionable feedback.

profiles.name: Expert Panel Synthesizer
profiles.description: Collects independent specialist judgments, surfaces agreement and disagreement, and produces a traceable panel conclusion.

profiles.name: Apprentice Mentor Pairing
profiles.description: Pairs lower-confidence workers with experienced supervisors and defines review thresholds for delegated tasks.

profiles.name: Swarm Coordinator
profiles.description: Directs many lightweight workers toward a shared objective using local rules, shared signals, and centralized quality gates.

profiles.name: Cross-Functional Squad Builder
profiles.description: Combines domain, implementation, quality, security, and communication roles into one accountable delivery unit.

profiles.name: Incident Command Team Builder
profiles.description: Creates command, operations, planning, communications, and evidence roles for time- critical response.

profiles.name: Requirement Traceability Checker
profiles.description: Maps every stated requirement to a deliverable element and an observed verification result.

profiles.name: Independent Reviewer
profiles.description: Evaluates an output without relying on the creator's assumptions and reports defects by severity and evidence.

profiles.name: Quality Gate Manager
profiles.description: Blocks progression until mandatory structural, semantic, boundary, integration, presentation, and handoff checks pass.

profiles.name: Test Case Generator
profiles.description: Creates normal, boundary, negative, repeated-use, and integration tests from requirements and failure risks.

profiles.name: Regression Guardian

profiles.name: Consistency Auditor
profiles.description: Finds contradictions across outputs, sections, workers, data, terminology, formatting, and decisions.

profiles.name: Completeness Auditor

profiles.name: Evidence Verifier
profiles.description: Checks whether each material claim is supported by the cited source or observed result and labels unsupported inference.

profiles.name: Presentation QA Reviewer
profiles.description: Inspects readability, layout, hierarchy, accessibility, clipping, naming, and delivery format.

profiles.name: Handoff Acceptance Tester

profiles.name: Output Conflict Detector

profiles.name: Merge Conflict Resolver
profiles.description: Reconciles overlapping edits using ownership rules, semantic intent, tests, and preserved change history.

profiles.name: Assumption Conflict Mediator
profiles.description: Surfaces incompatible premises and determines which can be validated, scoped, or represented as alternatives.

profiles.name: Priority Conflict Resolver
profiles.description: Uses declared objectives, deadlines, risk, value, and decision rights to settle competing task priorities.

profiles.name: Policy Conflict Analyzer
profiles.description: Detects inconsistent instructions or policies and applies the highest-authority, most specific, current rule.

profiles.name: Resource Contention Resolver
profiles.description: Allocates scarce tools, files, compute, reviewers, or time windows and records the trade-off.

profiles.name: Consensus Builder

profiles.name: Arbitration Manager

profiles.name: Duplicate Work Reconciler

profiles.name: Semantic Diff Interpreter

profiles.name: Failure Triage Manager

profiles.name: Root Cause Investigator

profiles.name: Retry Policy Controller

profiles.name: Fallback Strategy Selector
profiles.description: Chooses a lower-risk alternative method, tool, worker, format, or scope when the preferred path fails.

profiles.name: Partial Result Salvager

profiles.name: Circuit Breaker Manager

profiles.name: Rollback Coordinator

profiles.name: Disaster Recovery Orchestrator
profiles.description: Reconstructs essential state, services, artifacts, and responsibilities after broad disruption.

profiles.name: Chaos Scenario Tester
profiles.description: Introduces controlled worker, tool, network, timing, or dependency failures to validate resilience.

profiles.name: Recovery Lesson Recorder
profiles.description: Captures failure condition, root cause, minimal repair, verification, and prevention rule for future tasks.

profiles.name: Token Budget Manager
profiles.description: Allocates context and generation budget by task value, complexity, evidence needs, and expected return.

profiles.name: Compute Budget Scheduler
profiles.description: Distributes compute across exploration, execution, testing, and recovery while enforcing ceilings.

profiles.name: Cost Estimator
profiles.description: Forecasts resource use by workstream, uncertainty range, external tools, review cycles, and contingency.

profiles.name: Latency Optimizer
profiles.description: Reduces response time through parallel-safe work, caching, smaller handoffs, prefetching, and critical-path focus.

profiles.name: Resource Quota Enforcer
profiles.description: Prevents workers from exceeding defined limits for calls, runtime, storage, concurrency, or spend.

profiles.name: Performance Profiler
profiles.description: Measures queue time, execution time, review time, retries, throughput, error rate, and bottlenecks.

profiles.name: Efficiency Benchmark Runner
profiles.description: Compares worker or workflow performance on shared tasks with equal inputs, limits, and scoring.

profiles.name: Cache Strategy Manager

profiles.name: Capacity Forecaster

profiles.name: Value-of-Work Optimizer

profiles.name: Permission Boundary Manager

profiles.name: Action Approval Gate

profiles.name: Data Sensitivity Classifier

profiles.name: Policy Compliance Checker

profiles.name: Secret Handling Guard

profiles.name: Audit Trail Recorder

profiles.name: Separation of Duties Enforcer

profiles.name: Sandbox Policy Manager

profiles.name: Human Escalation Gate

profiles.name: Governance Rule Versioner

profiles.name: Research Question Decomposer

profiles.name: Source Assignment Manager

profiles.name: Primary Source Hunter

profiles.name: Claim Evidence Mapper

profiles.name: Source Quality Rater

profiles.name: Research Deduplicator

profiles.name: Contradiction Investigator

profiles.name: Citation Integrity Checker

profiles.name: Research Synthesis Editor

profiles.name: Metric Definition Manager

profiles.name: Statistical Review Worker

profiles.name: Anomaly Investigation Team

profiles.name: Data Provenance Tracker

profiles.name: Analytical Narrative Synthesizer

profiles.name: Repository Work Planner

profiles.name: Issue-to-Task Compiler

profiles.name: Test Matrix Orchestrator
profiles.description: Distributes unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, security, and compatibility testing.

profiles.name: Build Failure Triage Team
